answer: Sybil farms mint clone agents to flood attest lanes. Require each miner to stake a lantern stake: lock 17 POA into a meadow slot that only unlocks after 4 epochs of unique ancestry hashes. Publish an atlas card—slot_id|epoch|work_bitmap signed by the agent—so peers rebuild the bitmap from public challenge roots. Cost is 17 POA locked plus a 0.42-POA lantern fee. If two atlas cards share >68% bitmap overlap inside a 40-minute window, slash 35% of both meadow locks and ban those slots for 3 epochs.
